requirements.statement: A User can sign in with their provisioned account to securely access their own todos

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is directed to sign in before reaching the todo list
A signed-in user reaches their own todo list after authenticating
A user cannot access another user's todo items

requirements.statement: A User can add a new todo item with a title

criteria.must: Submitting a title creates a new todo item visible in the user's list
A newly created todo item starts as not completed

requirements.statement: A User can view all of their todo items, seeing what is outstanding and what is done

criteria.must: The todo list shows every todo item belonging to the signed-in user
Completed and incomplete items are visibly distinguishable in the list

requirements.statement: A User can mark a todo item as complete

criteria.must: Marking an incomplete todo item as complete updates its status

requirements.statement: A User can mark a completed todo item back as incomplete

criteria.must: Marking a completed todo item as incomplete updates its status back

requirements.statement: A User can delete a todo item they no longer need

criteria.must: Deleting a todo item removes it from the user's list

requirements.statement: A User can edit the title of an existing todo item

criteria.must: Editing a todo item's title saves the new title and displays it in the list
